name: Thumbtack
physical_step: independent pros do the job; platform only matches
ai_role: matching requests to pros; no AI detail published
traction: revenue about USD 400 m in FY2024 (Wikipedia citing Fast Company); valued USD 3.2 bn in June 2021
pl_adaptation_angle: Oferteo and Fixly already sell leads in Polish (V4-PL-001, V4-PL-002)

name: Taskrabbit
physical_step: freelance Taskers assemble furniture and mount TVs at the buyer's home
ai_role: matching and booking; no AI detail published
traction: IKEA bought 100% (price undisclosed, 2017); about 60,000 Taskers at the time; over 3.4 m furniture-assembly jobs per the company site (reported 2025)
repeat_signal: assembly booked at each furniture purchase (inference)
works_in_poland: unknown (IKEA Poland offers assembly; Taskrabbit brand in Poland unverified)
pl_adaptation_angle: an assembly or mounting slot sold at checkout by a Polish furniture or TV shop; Taskrabbit shows the retailer is the channel

name: Angi (incl. Handy)
launched: Handy acquired by ANGI Homeservices Oct 2018
physical_step: local pros install or assemble what the buyer bought at Walmart
ai_role: fixed-price service catalogue; no AI detail published
traction: Walmart sells Angi services (150+ projects) online since Feb 2022: furniture assembly from USD 49, TV mounting from USD 79; Handy previously sold installation in 2,000+ Walmart stores
pl_adaptation_angle: fixed-price installation added to a Polish shop's checkout (RTV Euro AGD, Media Expert offer own services; check in T09)

name: Puls
physical_step: own technicians repair phones, mount TVs and fix appliances at the home
ai_role: dispatch and scheduling; no AI detail published
traction: raised USD 50 m (2018, led by Temasek), over USD 90 m in total then; USD 15 m more in 2021 for an appliance-warranty product
hype_warnings: pivoted from phones to TV mounting, appliances and warranty: the core service did not carry the business alone
pl_adaptation_angle: needs a technician network; capital-heavy for this founder

name: Velofix
physical_step: franchisees drive van workshops to the rider's door
ai_role: online booking; no AI detail published
traction: 50th franchise sold (June 2016); first company-owned vans in 2019; about 130 locations per a 2025 franchise guide (unverified)
pl_adaptation_angle: franchise of vans needs capital; a Polish version would book existing mobile mechanics

name: Knife Aid
physical_step: sharpeners work in a central shop; the buyer posts knives in a prepaid envelope
traction: sold through Zwilling's US shop: 7 knives USD 89, 14 knives USD 149, shipping free both ways, minimum 4 knives
repeat_signal: knives need sharpening every few months (inference)
hype_warnings: heavy deal-site distribution (StackSocial, Boing Boing deals) at discounts
pl_adaptation_angle: InPost locker round trip; a knife maker or kitchen shop as the channel; check InPost rules for blades

name: ecoATM / Gazelle
physical_step: kiosks and mail-in boxes collect phones; graded in Louisville and resold
traction: Gazelle bought for USD 18 m (2015); more than 4 m devices bought per year (TechRepublic headline, date unverified)
pl_adaptation_angle: trade-in by post exists in Poland via operators and shops (unverified); holds stock of used phones

name: iCracked
physical_step: independent technicians travel to the customer to repair phones
traction: described in 2013 as an 'Uber for iPhone repairs' growing fast; current status unverified (Dealroom profile in past tense)
hype_warnings: unclear end; on-demand repair model not shown to last
pl_adaptation_angle: see V4-PL-003 (Digital Care): Polish repair is centralised, sent by courier, not technician visits

name: Shyp (dead)
physical_step: couriers collected items and packed and shipped them
traction: shut down March 2018; CEO said the company chased consumers too long and expanded too fast
hype_warnings: growth before unit economics; cut New York, Chicago, LA in 2017
pl_adaptation_angle: no gap: InPost lockers solved this in Poland

name: Cobbler Concierge
physical_step: in-house cobblers; customer ships shoes with a prepaid label
ai_role: text-message estimate from photos (no AI detail)
traction: traction unknown; launched to bring big-city repair quality to the rest of the US
pl_adaptation_angle: a Polish shoemaker plus InPost labels and photo quotes; Żabka already offers shoe repair drop-off (V4-PL-003 note)

name: Laundryheap
physical_step: drivers collect and return; partner laundries clean
ai_role: routing and scheduling; no AI detail published
traction: GBP 2 m angel round at GBP 17 m valuation and GBP 2 m revenue (2017); USD 3.5 m Series A (2021); bought rival Laundrapp (2022)
hype_warnings: consolidation of a crowded market (Laundrapp, Zipjet folded in)
pl_adaptation_angle: Polish laundries exist; a pickup layer needs courier cost below the order margin; no Polish app found (§7)

name: Laundrapp (folded)
physical_step: drivers and partner cleaners
traction: entered administration 21 Feb 2020 and bought by Inc & Co; merged with Zipjet in 2019; sold to Laundryheap in 2022
hype_warnings: cash-flow trouble despite corporate backers (Henkel, Bosch, Rocket Internet)
pl_adaptation_angle: graveyard lesson: pickup laundry margins are thin

name: Sojo
physical_step: bike couriers collect clothes; local tailors repair
ai_role: app matches jobs to tailors; no AI detail published
traction: pre-seed about USD 2.4 m (EUR 2.2 m), Apr 2022
pl_adaptation_angle: tailors exist in every Polish town; the gap is booking and collection, not skill (inference)

name: The Restory (dead)
physical_step: own workshop repaired bags and shoes for brands and Selfridges/Harrods customers
traction: founders left Feb 2023; company put into liquidation; high costs and thin margins reported; about 850 items returned to owners
hype_warnings: own workshop as a cost base; investor takeover before collapse
pl_adaptation_angle: graveyard lesson: do not own the workshop; route to existing craftsmen

name: The Seam
physical_step: independent makers and tailors repair; local drop-off or post
ai_role: matching to makers; no AI detail published
traction: GBP 250,000 pre-seed (Nov 2021); eBay UK/BFC Circular Fashion Innovator's Fund prize (2023)
pl_adaptation_angle: a directory plus booking for Polish tailors; brand partnerships (repair offered at a fashion brand's checkout)

name: Clothes Doctor
physical_step: customer posts the item; seamstresses repair and post back in 7–10 days
ai_role: online quote from photos; staff assign the job to a seamstress
traction: customers order 3–4 times a year at about GBP 80 per order; GBP 500,000 regional investment (2022) and later GBP 1 m round
repeat_signal: 3–4 orders per customer per year; detergent top-up subscriptions (Ellen MacArthur Foundation case)
pl_adaptation_angle: photo quote plus InPost return; a care-product subscription for repeat revenue

name: musicMagpie
physical_step: customers post phones, discs and books; graded and resold
ai_role: instant price quote by barcode or model (rules-based)
traction: revenue GBP 136.6 m FY2023 (down from 145.3 m); GBP 53.8 m in H1 2024, down 13%
pl_adaptation_angle: holds stock of used goods; out of scope for this founder

name: Checkatrade
physical_step: vetted trades do the work
traction: revenue GBP 131.5 m (2025), over 53,000 member trades, over 6 m reviews (Wikipedia)
pl_adaptation_angle: Polish lead platforms exist; a vetted-trade badge with real checks is the open angle (inference)

name: Knife Sharp
physical_step: sharpeners in a workshop; knives sent by post
traction: traction unknown; offers sharpening and repairs by post (Trustpilot profile)
pl_adaptation_angle: see V4-US-006

name: Helpling
physical_step: independent cleaners clean homes
ai_role: matching and booking; no AI detail published
traction: USD 22.5 m round led by ProSiebenSat.1, about USD 97 m raised in total (date about 2019, unverified); active in 50 German cities
hype_warnings: heavy funding; most cleaning work in Germany stays cash and informal (Yahoo/Reuters)
pl_adaptation_angle: cleaning is not a purchase-friction case; skip

name: MyHammer
physical_step: craftsmen do the work
traction: over 41,000 craftsmen; over 100,000 clients post jobs each month (average Jan–Dec 2025, company page)
pl_adaptation_angle: Oferteo/Fixly equivalent already in Poland

name: MyPhoneRepair
physical_step: central workshop; phones sent by post
traction: Stiftung Warentest test winner among online repair services (pre-2020 test); repaired all phones in 1–2 weeks without faults
pl_adaptation_angle: Polish mail-in repair exists (Digital Care); trust from an independent test is the angle

name: Zipjet (merged)
launched: 2014 launch in London (Rocket Internet); Berlin 2015, Paris 2016
physical_step: drivers and partner cleaners
traction: Series B closed (Apr 2018); bought Asteria Cleaners (2016); merged with Laundrapp (Mar 2019)
hype_warnings: merger of two loss-making rivals (inference from Laundrapp's later administration)
pl_adaptation_angle: graveyard lesson, see V4-GB-002

name: Werkspot (Instapro)
physical_step: craftsmen do the work
traction: about 120 staff in Amsterdam; part of HomeAdvisor since 2013 (company page)
pl_adaptation_angle: Oferteo/Fixly equivalent already in Poland

name: Tilli
physical_step: network of about 250 tailors in about 20 cities comes to the home (2022)
ai_role: booking; Shopify app lets fashion brands offer repair appointments
traction: EUR 400,000 (2018) and EUR 1.2 m seed; about 250 tailors in about 20 cities (2022); expanded offer to other European brands (2024)
hype_warnings: moved from consumers to B2B brand deals (pivot)
pl_adaptation_angle: sell repair-as-a-service to Polish fashion brands (Shoper/Shopify app) rather than to consumers; French repair bonus is a regulatory driver Poland lacks

name: Repamera
physical_step: tailors repair; items sent by parcel or via brand partners
ai_role: online order; no AI detail published
traction: EIT Climate-KIC start-up; started the Swedish 'White Monday' campaign; mixed Trustpilot reviews including an unresolved order from Nov 2025
pl_adaptation_angle: same as V4-GB-006; delays show the operating risk

name: Mittanbud
physical_step: craftsmen do the work
traction: sold with Servicefinder (SE), Remppatori (FI) and 3byggetilbud (DK) to Verdane at NOK 550 m enterprise value; 250,000–300,000 projects a year in Norway (job posting)
pl_adaptation_angle: category is mature in Poland (Oferteo); no gap for a generalist

name: Otovo
physical_step: partner installers fit solar panels; Otovo sells and finances
ai_role: automated roof and price quote from address (no AI detail published)
traction: 1,704 units sold in Q1 2024; listed in Oslo
repeat_signal: subscription revenue about one third of Q4 2024 revenue (earnings call, unverified)
hype_warnings: sales fell 13% year on year in a weak solar market
pl_adaptation_angle: coordinated installation with instant quote; Polish PV and heat-pump installers already sell online (see V2 Pompy.app, Enerad)

name: Lenet (リネット)
physical_step: courier collects; own or partner factories clean
traction: 200,000 users (Sept 2016); over 400,000 (May 2020); paid membership model
hype_warnings: TV advertising limited by factory capacity (2015 report)
pl_adaptation_angle: dry-cleaning by courier with InPost lockers; needs a partner cleaner with capacity

name: Orange Heel Repair Center
physical_step: own repair centre; Yamato collects
traction: about 20,000 pairs repaired a year (company press release, date unverified)
pl_adaptation_angle: shoe repair by post with courier pickup; Polish shoemakers are local and offline (inference)

name: Laundrygo (런드리고)
physical_step: own smart lockers at the door; own factories clean overnight
ai_role: factory automation and robot packing; no AI detail published
traction: revenue KRW 55.7 bn (about USD 41 m) in 2024, up from KRW 1.6 bn in 2019; over KRW 100 bn raised; LG Electronics invested KRW 10 bn (Oct 2025)
hype_warnings: growth funded by large rounds and own factories
pl_adaptation_angle: own factories are out of scope; shows overnight laundry works in dense cities

name: Soomgo (숨고)
physical_step: pros do the work
traction: revenue KRW 62.4 bn and operating profit KRW 13.7 bn in 2024 (company job posting); 2 m pros and 14 m customers (company claim)
pl_adaptation_angle: Oferteo shows the lead model is profitable in Poland too

name: Fixly
physical_step: pros do the work
traction: supplier base grew from 770 to 6,820 in about a month after launch (2017); over 200,000 orders (Wprost, date unverified)
pl_adaptation_angle: incumbent: a generalist lead platform in Polish already exists

name: Oferteo
how_it_earns: lead-fee (providers buy points to unlock contacts)
physical_step: providers do the work
traction: net revenue PLN 42 m in FY Apr 2022–Mar 2023; over 1.85 m confirmed orders in that year (company release); filed IPO prospectus with KNF
pl_adaptation_angle: incumbent for leads; a niche booked-and-fulfilled service is where it leaves room (inference)

name: Digital Care (repair via Żabka)
physical_step: customer drops the phone at one of about 10,000 Żabka shops; courier takes it to the central workshop; repair within 7 working days, 90-day warranty
ai_role: online quote; no AI detail published
traction: about 60,000 repair requests in summer months (Digital Care data, year unverified); free shipping from about 10,000 Żabka shops; also handles insurance repairs for Orange, Play, Plus and T-Mobile (Telepolis)
pl_adaptation_angle: phone repair by post is covered in Poland; Żabka also runs shoe-repair drop-off (headline, wiadomoscihandlowe 2024), so the shop-as-drop-off pattern is taken

name: woshwosh (with Żabka)
launched: Żabka shoe service from June 2023; tailoring from Dec 2025
physical_step: buyer orders online, leaves shoes or clothes at a chosen Żabka shop and collects them there; woshwosh and partner craftsmen clean and repair (10 days cleaning, 14 days repair)
ai_role: online ordering via woshwosh.zabka.pl or the Żappka app; no AI detail published
traction: Żabka shoe cleaning and repair launched June 2023; tailoring alterations added Dec 2025
pl_adaptation_angle: incumbent drop-off network for shoe and clothing repair already exists in Poland; whether the shoe service still runs is unverified

name: NejŘemeslníci
physical_step: craftsmen do the work
traction: over 30,000 craft firms; about 70,000 verified requests a year (company blog, dates mixed); viewing requests free for providers
pl_adaptation_angle: shows the same generalist model in CZ; Polish equivalents exist
